title: Moses' burning bush as a plasmoid
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Moses' burning bush as a plasmoid, about biblical era at Mount Sinai, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Moses speaking to the burning bush could be like a plasmoid or whatever that's, you know, kind of a modern UFO encounter.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, suggests that the Bible story of Moses speaking to a burning bush on Mount Sinai could have been a plasmoid, a glowing ball of electrically charged gas, and so a kind of modern UFO encounter. He draws on a book by the author Robert Temple called A New Science of Heaven, and the idea would mean some ancient religious visions were the same thing people now report as UFOs.
